title: Autonomous electronic explanation of imine-site selectivity
difficulty_reasons: The object and observables are fixed and there is no candidate discovery space.
Difficulty lies in selecting and validating a defensible independent computational route and comparing interpretations, with a bounded-failure path available.

data.description: 67-atom neutral Cartesian geometry of compound 3a; atom indices are XYZ coordinate-line order.

required_deliverables.description: Validated calculation provenance, atom mapping, NPA charges when obtained or bounded-failure diagnostics, comparison, candidate interpretations, conclusion, and limitations.
